STEERING — Power Steering (Gear Housing)
SR-87

9. INSTALL SELF-LOCKING NUT
Using SST, install a new self-locking nut.
SST 09616-00010
Torque: 600 kg-cm (43 ft-lb, 59 N-m)

10. INSTALL RACK HOUSING CAP
(a) Apply sealant to 2 or 3 threads of the cap.
Sealant: Part No. 08833-00080, THREE BOND 1344,
LOCTITE 242 or equivalent
(b) Install the cap.
Torque: 700 kg-cm (51 ft-lb, 69 N-m)

(c) Using a pin punch and hammer, stake the cap.

11. INSTALL RACK GUIDE SEAT, RACK GUIDE AND RACK
GUIDE SPRING

12. ADJUST TOTAL PRELOAD
(a) Apply sealant to 2 or 3 threads of the spring cap.
Sealant: Part No. 08833-00080, THREE BOND 1344,
LOCTITE 242 or equivalent
(b) Using SST, install and torque the spring cap.
SST 09612-24014 (09612-10022)
Torque: 250 kg-cm (18 ft-lb, 25 N-m)
